- [TS3004a:13:36] The group decided to make the remote a universal remote.
- [TS3004b:08:39] The remote will not feature speech recognition or an LCD screen.
- [TS3004b:25:59] The remote will light up when a button is pressed, much like a mobile phone.
- [TS3004b:35:01] The remote will feature teletext capabilities, and the teletext buttons will be included on the main interface.
- [TS3004c:13:03] The group decided to use a scroll button for volume control.
- [TS3004c:37:19] It will be small and yellow, to use one of the colors of the Real Reaction logo.
- [TS3004c:22:48] The remote will include rechargeable batteries and will be used with a recharging stand. (replaces a remote without a recharging dock)
- [TS3004c:19:18] The remote will feature plastic buttons and casing, rather than rubber.
- [TS3004c:24:33] The remote will not feature an LCD screen.
- [TS3004c:25:41] The remote will feature a double-curved, rounded square design.
- [TS3004c:31:41] The group decided to design five changeable faces for the device.
- [TS3004c:39:13] They eventually decided to incorporate speech recognition and an advanced chip. (replaces a remote without speech recognition)
